patterns.title: Access denied
patterns.summary: An operation was refused for lack of permission.

remediation.detail: Confirm which account ran the step and its rights on the target.
Controlled Folder Access, ASR and EDR can deny writes that NTFS allows.

patterns.title: File or resource in use
patterns.summary: A file the installer needed was locked by another process.

remediation.detail: Stop the running app before the update, or use a blocking-process policy.
A real-time AV scan of the file can hold it briefly.

patterns.title: Not enough disk space
patterns.summary: The disk ran out of space during the operation.

remediation.detail: Remove old IME and Windows Update caches if they are large.

patterns.title: Blocked by application control policy
regex: This program is blocked by group policy
(?:blocked|prevented|denied) by (?:AppLocker|WDAC|Software Restriction|Windows Defender Application Control|Smart App Control)
patterns.summary: Application control (AppLocker, WDAC, Smart App Control or Software Restriction Policy) blocked something the install tried to run.

remediation.detail: Allow the publisher or hash that was blocked.

patterns.title: Code signature or certificate problem
patterns.summary: Windows could not verify the signature on a file, usually because the root certificate is untrusted, a certificate has expired, or the file was altered.

remediation.action: Check the device trusts the chain
remediation.detail: Make sure the root and intermediate certificates are present and time is correct.

patterns.title: Name resolution failed
regex: The remote name could not be resolved
patterns.summary: A host name could not be resolved, so the download or service call never started.

remediation.detail: Make sure the device resolves the same names off-network.

patterns.title: Network connection failed or timed out
regex: Unable to connect to the remote server
patterns.summary: The device could not reach a required endpoint.

remediation.detail: Confirm the Microsoft and vendor endpoints are allowed.

patterns.title: TLS or certificate trust failure
patterns.summary: A secure connection failed certificate or protocol checks - common behind SSL inspection or with a wrong system clock.

remediation.detail: Exclude Intune and vendor download hosts from SSL inspection.
Make sure it is in the device Trusted Root store.

patterns.title: Proxy requires authentication
patterns.summary: A proxy refused the request and asked for credentials. Services running as SYSTEM usually cannot answer that.

remediation.action: Exempt the required endpoints from proxy authentication
remediation.detail: Use a PAC rule or an allow-list for SYSTEM traffic.

patterns.title: Security software interfered
patterns.summary: Security software appears to have blocked or removed something.

remediation.detail: Only after confirming the file is legitimate.
